laterChapters.completionText: A boatwoman follows the river landmarks on the chart, then takes a turn at the steady telescope. She points out the same stars to her companions. They take the route you have recorded, not a promise of directions later.

Children trace the river in the pictures while their parents compare the mosaic. A visitor tucks the catalogue beside her flora. The artist leaves the gallery open and comes with you for one last look at the landing.

objectives.text: Place floating lantern at the gathering landing

laterChapters.completionText: The atlas is passed from hand to hand, and a lantern floats safely inside the sheltered landing basin. At the table, someone saves your seat. From four beginnings, a river full of things and people to return to.

cue.text: By morning, people are asking which way to go and when the boats leave. We set aside the evening work to make the landing easier to understand.

remainingTimekeeping.completionText: The keeper reads the return times aloud and calls the boats in order. The first homeward passengers wave from the steps, while others settle in for the evening. No one has to leave before their own boat is called.
